contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Gratian (367-383), Emperor standing issue of 367-375, Arles mint, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Emperor standing right with propped shield and standard. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI]. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 1.57gms, die axis: 6
